description: After the user chooses a task to continue, attach the actual current session to it. Use the client and session ID from the local plugin context, never guess IDs. Pass continues: the session_id (from get_task_context) of the session you are continuing, usually the latest one you read; your session then goes on in that session's draft, so one Build shows the work of both agents. This records a private link; it does not upload or publish history.

continues.description: The session_id of the task's session you are continuing, from get_task_context sources.

name: attach_session_to_task
title: Attach Session To Task
